# Sample pack credits
The packs here are trimmed, resampled (mono 22.05 kHz, 8-bit mu-law) copies built by `tools/pack.js`.

| Pack | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `fluid-piano.js` | FluidR3_GM "Acoustic Grand Piano" by Frank Wen, as MP3 notes from [gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts](https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts) | [CC-BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) |
| `fluid-guitar.js` | FluidR3_GM "Acoustic Guitar (steel)", same source | CC-BY 3.0 |
| `fluid-epiano.js` | FluidR3_GM "Electric Piano 1", same source | CC-BY 3.0 |
| `vcsl-kit.js` | [Versilian Community Sample Library](https://github.com/sgossner/VCSL): Bass Drum 1, Snare Drum Modern 1, Hi-Hat Cymbal, Tom 1 / Tom 2 (stick), Claps, Suspended Cymbal 1 | [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) |

Notes per melodic pack: every 4 semitones (C, E, G#), C2 to C7 (guitar E2 to C6); the player pitches between them.
